text: すこし　たかい　けど　ねむけざまし　どくけし　などを　バラバラに　かうより　らくちん！

structure.jp: すこし　たかい　けど
ねむけざまし　どくけし　などを
バラバラに　かうより

patterns.name: 〜より
patterns.explanation: より means 'than' and comes after the thing being compared against. バラバラに　かうより = 'than buying them separately'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど at the end of a sentence part means 'but' in a casual way. たかい　けど = 'it's pricey, but'.
